data.name: Kadaniel
data.gender_notes: Kadaniel is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Kadaniel is derived from the Hebrew words 'Kad' (east) and 'El' (God). It means 'God is my righteousness'. This name is mentioned in the Bible as a name of an angel or a heavenly being. It symbolizes the idea of being protected and sustained by God. The name Kadaniel carries the meaning “God is my righteousness” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Kadaniel usually hope their child will grow to embody god is my righteousness and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that evokes a sense of divine protection and righteousness.
data.etymology: Kadaniel belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God is my righteousness.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kadaniel total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

historical_references.reference: In the 13th century, a monk named Caesarius of Heisterbach wrote in his 'Dialogus Miraculorum' about a holy hermit named Kadaniel who lived near the Rhine River in present-day Germany. He was known for performing miracles and was visited by many pilgrims.
